csv_project_name: Engineering Service for Gladstone Community Center HVAC
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Gladstone, MO, a political subdivision of the State of Missouri (hereinafter referred to as City) will receive qualification proposal responses (Proposals) from individuals, corporations, partnerships, and other legal entities authorized to do business in the State of Missouri (Proposers), to provide professional services as specified in this Request for Qualifications. The Successful Proposer (hereinafter in this Scope referred to as Consultant) shall furnish all labor, equipment, materials, supplies, licensing, transportation, and other components necessary to provide Professional Mechanical/HVAC Engineering Services and other professional services for the Gladstone Community Center Natatorium HVAC Replacement Project. All services shall meet the requirements of the Agreement and include, but are not limited to, the following disciplines and sub-disciplines: 1. Mechanical Engineering HVAC System Engineering, Load Calculations, and System Design 2. Natatorium Environmental Control System Engineering 3. Structural Engineering (related to roof replacement and rooftop equipment support) 4. Electrical Engineering (related to HVAC power and controls) 5. Building Controls & Automation Engineering 6. Plumbing Engineering (saltwater conversion impacts, condensate, and drainage modifications) 7. Environmental & Air Quality Engineering (chloramine reduction, indoor air quality) 8. Roofing Engineering (coordination of roof replacement for equipment installation) 9. Civil Engineering (parking lot resurfacing design associated with crane mobilization) 10. Construction Phasing & Facility Shutdown Planning 11. Cost Estimation & Scheduling 12. Permitting and Regulatory Agency Coordination 13. HUD Environmental Review and CPF Compliance Support 14.Public Infrastructure Funding Coordination (if required for federal DOT grants) The Consultant shall follow all requirements set forth by the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) to facilitate the use of Community Project Funding (CPF) on this project.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
